_source: TRANSLATED from component_families.json by hand — not extracted
_why: The reference architecture states each family's trigger as prose ('is D1 or above', 'has a blast radius of cohort or population'). Step 22 has to evaluate them, and NFR-15 forbids compiling rules into the orchestrator, so each is restated in the same expression language the guardrail predicates use and evaluated by the same evaluator. The verbatim prose travels with every entry so a reviewer can check the translation rather than trust it; where the prose says something the language cannot express, the entry says so in 'unexpressed' instead of pretending.

families.name: Grounding and retrieval
families.prose: reads a grounding source — federated variant where sources exceed one

variant.name: federated
variant.unexpressed: The count of grounding sources is a property of the retrieval contracts from step 11, not of a step's facet vector. The caller supplies it as 'grounding_sources'.

families.name: Semantic binding
families.prose: reasons over or emits a named concept
families.predicate: the step reasons over or emits a named concept

families.name: Action and transaction
families.prose: has an effect class of record write or above
families.predicate: step.effect ∈ {record write, external communication, financial or contractual commitment, physical or clinical action}

families.name: Authorisation and approval
families.prose: commits with an authorisation other than autonomous

families.name: Identity and access
families.prose: always — shape varies with the trigger modifier

families.name: Evaluation
families.prose: always — sized by the highest influence class present

families.name: Observation and assurance
families.prose: carries influence 2+, or consumes grounding that can go stale

families.name: Evidence and retention
families.prose: has any effect, or operates in a regulated domain
families.predicate: step.effect ≠ none ∨ step.domain ∈ {clinical, financial, HR, safety}

families.name: Content inspection
families.prose: reads content the enterprise did not author
families.predicate: step reads any grounding source, tool output or agent response — any content the enterprise did not author

families.name: Egress control
families.prose: emits externally, or reads confidential or restricted data

families.name: Release and rate control
families.prose: has a blast radius of cohort or population
